skills.description: Identify bird species from an audio OR video file using the BirdNET v2.4 acoustic model. Use when the user provides a media file (mp4/mov/wav/mp3/m4a/etc.) and asks "what bird is this", "识别鸟叫/鸟种", "分辨这是什么鸟", "音视频鸟鸣识别", or wants acoustic bird-call identification. Auto-extracts the audio track (no system ffmpeg required), applies a dynamic geographic/phenological genus-weighting table (not a hard whitelist) covering 400+ genera, and includes a rhythm/churring detector covering BirdNET's blind spots for continuous vocalizations (nightjars, woodpecker drumming). Also detects and flags non-bird sound sources (frogs, insects, ambient noise) instead of silently misreporting them as birds. Supports batch processing of an entire folder of recordings with a standardized priority-tier report for annotation triage. Can generate a spectrogram for verification. Fully portable — no hardcoded machine paths.

skills.description: Using fixed cameras at home (living room, bedroom) of elderly people living alone, the system analyzes daily videos and detects negative behavior indicators during solo time: dazing (long-duration motionless gazing without purposeful action), sighing (rapid chest rise-and-fall with audible expiration), and self-talking (mouth movement without any conversation partner). It counts the frequency and duration of these behaviors and comprehensively evaluates the elder's emotional risk level (low / medium / high). The skill assists family members or community workers in understanding the elder's mental state and timely providing emotional care or psychological intervention. Application scenarios: homes of solo-living elders, nursing homes, community daycare centers. The system generates a daily emotional-risk report; when the risk level is 'medium' or 'high', it pushes reminders. Skill features: loneliness and depression in the elderly are common mental-health issues, and early behavioral signals are often overlooked. AI automatic monitoring of dazing / sighing / self-talking helps family members detect mental abnormalities early, intervene promptly, and improve the elder's quality of life. Can be integrated into home-care cameras or community health-management platforms. | 通过独居老人在家中的固定摄像头（如客厅、卧室），分析日常视频，检测独处期间的消极行为指标：发呆（长时间静止注视，缺乏目的性动作）、叹气（胸部快速起伏伴呼气声）、自言自语（口部活动但无对话对象）等。统计这些行为的发生频次和持续时间，综合评估老年人潜在的情绪风险等级（低/中/高）。该技能可辅助家属或社区工作者了解老人心理状态，及时进行情感关怀或心理干预。应用场景：独居老人家庭、养老院、社区日间照料中心。系统每日生成情绪风险报告，当风险等级为'中'或'高'时推送提醒。技能特点：老年人孤独和抑郁是常见的心理健康问题，早期行为信号常被忽视。通过AI自动监测发呆、叹气、自言自语等行为，可辅助家属及早发现心理异常，及时干预，提高老年人生活质量。该技能可集成到居家养老摄像头或社区健康管理平台中。

skills.description: 公文影像精修师 — 将政府公文照片/扫描件精准还原为符合 GB/T 9704-2012 标准的可编辑 Word 和 PDF 文档。 This skill should be used when the user provides one or more photos/scans of Chinese government official documents and requests OCR extraction, format restoration, or conversion to editable .docx/.pdf files. Trigger keywords include: 公文, 红头文件, 扫描件, OCR, 排版还原, 格式转换, 红头, 发文字号, GB/T 9704, 党政机关公文格式, 公文识别, 公文精修, 图片转文档, 扫描件转Word.
skills.description_zh:
🔴 一键将政府公文照片/扫描件还原为符合 GB/T 9704-2012 国标的可编辑 Word 和 PDF 文档。

【核心能力】
• 智能OCR识别 + 高频易错词库自动纠错（形近字、的地得、公文术语等7大类）
• 100%复刻原件排版：红头、发文字号、层级序号、页边距、版记全按国标参数重建
• 输出真PDF（文字可选/可复制），拒绝图片型PDF
• 自动处理表格还原、公章位置标注、敏感信息脱敏

【适用场景】
✅ 红头文件拍照存档 → 可编辑Word归档
✅ 扫描件批量数字化 → 标准格式统一输出
✅ 公文历史档案电子化 → GB/T 9704合规转换
✅ 政府机关/企事业单位文秘日常办公

【技术亮点】
• 内置完整 GB/T 9704-2012 排版规范库（页边距37/35/28/26mm、字号体系、六角括号〔〕等全部参数）
• 附带图片预处理脚本（透视校正+倾斜校正+增强）和Word生成脚本
• 支持 Word(.docx) + PDF 双格式交付，含处理说明校对报告

触发词：公文、红头文件、扫描件、OCR、排版还原、格式转换、GB/T 9704
skills.name: 公文影像精修师
